title: EnterpriseRAG Notes
about: EnterpriseRAG-Bench (Onyx, 2026) cut to what people keep in Context: a made-up company's docs, wiki, meetings, tickets, pull requests and customer records filed as notes (its Slack and email left out, as Context saves neither), and the 343 questions whose answers are in them.

source.name: EnterpriseRAG-Bench (Onyx, arXiv 2605.05253), adapted: Slack and Gmail documents and every question citing them left out
source.data: onyx-dot-app/EnterpriseRAG-Bench on Hugging Face, fetched at run time at a pinned revision; never kept in this repository

runs.about: EnterpriseRAG-Bench without Slack or email: 343 questions over 10,000 of its notes (every cited one, the rest the closest-titled of the same kind), scored by nDCG@10 per question type. Embeddings only.

The same 343 questions and 10,000 notes, split the way a person reaches them: their own workspace (meetings) and three shared ones (engineering, wiki and docs, sales). Each search asks all four, so it measures ranking across workspaces. Embeddings only.
The same 343 questions over every one of its 104,967 docs, wiki pages, meetings, tickets, pull requests and customer records. Hours, and a few dollars of embeddings.
